document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async function() {
  const loading = document.getElementById('__bundler_loading');
  function setStatus(msg) { if (loading) loading.textContent = msg; }

  // Error sink persists across replaceWith since it's on window, not the DOM.
  window.addEventListener('error', function(e) {
    var p = document.body || document.documentElement;
    var d = document.getElementById('__bundler_err') || p.appendChild(document.createElement('div'));
    d.id = '__bundler_err';
    d.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:12px;left:12px;right:12px;font:12px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace;background:#2a1215;color:#ff8a80;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #5c2b2e;z-index:99999;white-space:pre-wrap;max-height:40vh;overflow:auto';
    d.textContent = (d.textContent ? d.textContent + String.fromCharCode(10) : '') +
      '[bundle] ' + (e.message || e.type) +
      (e.filename ? ' (' + e.filename.slice(0, 60) + ':' + e.lineno + ')' : '');
  }, true);

  try {
    const manifestEl = document.querySelector('script[type="__bundler/manifest"]');
    const templateEl = document.querySelector('script[type="__bundler/template"]');
    if (!manifestEl || !templateEl) {
      setStatus('Error: missing bundle data');
      console.error('[bundler] Missing script tags — manifestEl:', !!manifestEl, 'templateEl:', !!templateEl);
      return;
    }

    const manifest = JSON.parse(manifestEl.textContent);
    let template = JSON.parse(templateEl.textContent);

    const uuids = Object.keys(manifest);
    setStatus('Unpacking ' + uuids.length + ' assets...');

    const blobUrls = {};
    await Promise.all(uuids.map(async (uuid) => {
      const entry = manifest[uuid];
      try {
        const binaryStr = atob(entry.data);
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(binaryStr.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < binaryStr.length; i++) bytes[i] = binaryStr.charCodeAt(i);

        let finalBytes = bytes;
        if (entry.compressed) {
          if (typeof DecompressionStream !== 'undefined') {
            const ds = new DecompressionStream('gzip');
            const writer = ds.writable.getWriter();
            const reader = ds.readable.getReader();
            writer.write(bytes);
            writer.close();
            const chunks = [];
            let totalLen = 0;
            while (true) {
              const { done, value } = await reader.read();
              if (done) break;
              chunks.push(value);
              totalLen += value.length;
            }
            finalBytes = new Uint8Array(totalLen);
            let offset = 0;
            for (const chunk of chunks) { finalBytes.set(chunk, offset); offset += chunk.length; }
          } else {
            console.warn('DecompressionStream not available, asset ' + uuid + ' may not render');
          }
        }

        blobUrls[uuid] = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([finalBytes], { type: entry.mime }));
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to decode asset ' + uuid + ':', err);
        blobUrls[uuid] = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([], { type: entry.mime }));
      }
    }));

    const extResEl = document.querySelector('script[type="__bundler/ext_resources"]');
    const extResources = extResEl ? JSON.parse(extResEl.textContent) : [];
    const resourceMap = {};
    for (const entry of extResources) {
      if (blobUrls[entry.uuid]) resourceMap[entry.id] = blobUrls[entry.uuid];
    }

    setStatus('Rendering...');
    for (const uuid of uuids) template = template.split(uuid).join(blobUrls[uuid]);

    // Strip integrity + crossorigin — blob URLs from a file:// document inherit
    // a null origin, so crossorigin forces a CORS fetch that SRI then rejects.
    // The manifest bytes are ours; SRI protects against CDN compromise, not this.
    template = template.replace(/\s+integrity="[^"]*"/gi, '').replace(/\s+crossorigin="[^"]*"/gi, '');

    const resourceScript = '<script>window.__resources = ' +
      JSON.stringify(resourceMap).split('</' + 'script>').join('<\\/' + 'script>') +
      ';</' + 'script>';
    // Inject after <head> so the DOCTYPE stays first; prepending the script
    // would push the parser into quirks mode. DOMParser always emits a <head>
    // (synthesizing one if the source HTML omitted it) but may carry
    // attributes through, so match the full opening tag. slice() rather than
    // replace() keeps us clear of $-pattern substitution in resourceScript.
    const headOpen = template.match(/<head[^>]*>/i);
    if (headOpen) {
      const i = headOpen.index + headOpen[0].length;
      template = template.slice(0, i) + resourceScript + template.slice(i);
    }

    // Parse the template and swap the root element. Scripts inserted via
    // DOMParser/replaceWith are inert per spec — re-create each with
    // createElement so they execute, awaiting onload for src scripts to
    // preserve ordering (React before ReactDOM before Babel before text/babel).
    const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(template, 'text/html');
    document.documentElement.replaceWith(doc.documentElement);
    const dead = Array.from(document.scripts);
    for (const old of dead) {
      const s = document.createElement('script');
      for (const a of old.attributes) s.setAttribute(a.name, a.value);
      s.textContent = old.textContent;
      // text/babel scripts with a src: fetch and inline. transformScriptTags
      // does XHR against the src, but blob:null/ from a file:// origin is
      // silently dropped. Inlining makes it a plain inline babel script,
      // which transformScriptTags handles unconditionally.
      if ((s.type === 'text/babel' || s.type === 'text/jsx') && s.src) {
        const r = await fetch(s.src);
        s.textContent = await r.text();
        s.removeAttribute('src');
      }
      const p = s.src ? new Promise(function(r) { s.onload = s.onerror = r; }) : null;
      old.replaceWith(s);
      if (p) await p;
    }
    // Babel standalone auto-transforms type=text/babel on DOMContentLoaded,
    // which fired before we swapped the document. Trigger manually if present.
    if (window.Babel && typeof window.Babel.transformScriptTags === 'function') {
      window.Babel.transformScriptTags();
    }
  } catch (err) {
    setStatus('Error unpacking: ' + err.message);
    console.error('Bundle unpack error:', err);
  }
});

  DESIGN TOKENS\n\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550 */\n:root{\n  --white:#ffffff; --bg:#f0f4f8; --surface:#f8fafc;\n  --g100:#f1f5f9; --g200:#e2e8f0; --g300:#cbd5e1;\n  --g400:#94a3b8; --g500:#64748b; --g700:#334155; --g900:#0f172a;\n  --b50:#eff6ff;  --b100:#dbeafe; --b200:#bfdbfe; --b300:#93c5fd;\n  --b400:#60a5fa; --b500:#3b82f6; --b600:#4e7adb;\n  --b700:#4869c5; --b800:#2d448f; --b900:#1e3a8a;\n  --green:#059669;  --green-bg:#d1fae5;  --green-bd:#a7f3d0;\n  --amber:#d97706;  --amber-bg:#fef3c7;  --amber-bd:#fde68a;\n  --red:#dc2626;    --red-bg:#fee2e2;    --red-bd:#fca5a5;\n  --cyan:#0284c7;   --cyan-bg:#e0f2fe;\n  --gold:#b45309;   --gold-bg:#fef3c7;\n  --purple:#7c3aed; --purple-bg:#ede9fe; --purple-bd:#c4b5fd;\n  --neu-out:6px 6px 16px #c8d4e0,-6px -6px 16px #ffffff;\n  --neu-in:inset 3px 3px 8px #c8d4e0,inset -3px -3px 8px #ffffff;\n  --neu-sm:3px 3px 8px #c8d4e0,-3px -3px 8px #ffffff;\n  --radius:14px; --rsm:10px; --rxs:7px;\n  --font:'Inter',-apple-system,sans-serif;\n  --tr:.22s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);\n\n  /* Sidebar tokens */\n  --rail-w: 66px;\n  --panel-w: 228px;\n  --sb-bg: #ffffff;\n  --sb-rail-bg: #f8fafc;\n  --sb-border: #e2e8f0;\n  --sb-text: #64748b;\n  --sb-text-hover: #0f172a;\n  --sb-section-clr: #4a536a;\n  --sb-item-active-bg: #eff6ff;\n  --sb-item-active-border: #bfdbfe;\n  --sb-item-active-text: #4869c5;\n  --hdr-h: 58px;\n}\n\n*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}\nbody{font-family:var(--font);background:var(--bg);color:var(--g900);min-height:100vh;overflow-x:hidden}\n\n/* \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n   TOP HEADER\n\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550 */\n.hdr{\n  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:300;\n  height:var(--hdr-h);\n  background:var(--white);\n  border-bottom:1px solid var(--g200);\n  box-shadow:0 1px 10px rgba(37,99,235,.07);\n  display:flex;align-items:center;\n}\n.hdr-brand{\n  width:var(--rail-w);flex-shrink:0;\n  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;\n  height:100%;\n  border-right:1px solid var(--g200);\n  background:var(--sb-rail-bg);\n  box-shadow:1px 0 0 var(--sb-border);\n}\n.hdr-badge{\n  width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;\n  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--b800),var(--b500));\n  display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;\n  box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(37,99,235,.35);\n}\n.hdr-body{\n  flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;\n  justify-content:space-between;padding:0 24px;\n}\n.hdr-title-wrap .hdr-title{\n  font-family:'Inter',-apple-system,sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--g900);letter-spacing:-0.01em\n}\n.hdr-title-wrap .hdr-sub{\n  font-size:10.5px;color:var(--g400);margin-top:1px;letter-spacing:.03em\n}\n.hdr-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}\n.hdr-module-pill{\n  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;\n  padding:5px 14px;border-radius:20px;\n  font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em;\n  border:1.5px solid transparent;transition:var(--tr);\n}\n.hdr-module-pill.adm{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;border-color:var(--amber-bd)}\n.hdr-module-pill.acad{background:#d1fae5;color:#065f46;border-color:var(--green-bd)}\n.hdr-module-pill.home{background:var(--b50);color:var(--b800);border-color:var(--b200)}\n.hdr-intake{\n  background:var(--b50);border:1.5px solid var(--b200);border-radius:20px;\n  padding:5px 13px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--b700);\n}\n.hdr-user{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--g500);cursor:pointer}\n.hdr-avatar{\n  width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;\n  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--b700),var(--b500));\n  color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;\n}\n\n/* \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n   LAYOUT SHELL\n\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550 */\n.layout{\n  display:flex;\n  padding-top:var(--hdr-h);\n  min-height:100vh;\n}\n\n/* \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n   SIDEBAR  \u2014  GXON-style dual-column\n   Left: 66px icon rail (always visible)\n   Right: 228px slide-out panel (per module)\n\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550 */\n.sidebar{\n  position:fixed;\n  top:var(--hdr-h);left:0;\n  height:calc(100vh - var(--hdr-h));\n  display:flex;z-index:200;\n}\n\n/* \u2500\u2500 ICON RAIL \u2500\u2500 */\n.sb-rail{\n  width:var(--rail-w);flex-shrink:0;\n  background:var(--sb-rail-bg);\n  border-right:1px solid var(--sb-border);\n  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;\n  padding:12px 0;\n  gap:2px;\n  overflow:visible;\n  scrollbar-width:none;\n}\n.sb-rail::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}\n\n.rail-divider{\n  width:32px;height:1px;background:var(--sb-border);\n  margin:6px auto;flex-shrink:0;\n}\n.rail-spacer{flex:1}\n\n.rail-item{\n  position:relative;\n  width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:12px;\n  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;\n  cursor:pointer;\n  border:1.5px solid transparent;\n  transition:background var(--tr), border-color var(--tr);\n  flex-shrink:0;\n}\n.rail-item:hover:not(.locked):not(.active){\n  background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);\n  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(140%);\n  backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(140%);\n  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.6), 0 4px 14px rgba(15,23,42,.08);\n}\n.rail-item.active{\n  background:#3a5cbb;\n  border-color:#3a5cbb;\n}\n.rail-item.active .rail-label{color:#f8fafc}\n.rail-item.locked{\n  opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed;\n}\n\n/* Unified active colour for all rail items */\n.rail-item[data-mod].active{background:#3a5cbb;border-color:#3a5cbb;}\n.rail-item[data-mod].active .rail-label{color:#f8fafc}\n.rail-item[data-mod].active .rail-icon{color:#f8fafc}\n\n.rail-icon{\n  font-size:24px;line-height:1;\n  color:#3a5cbb;\n  transition:transform var(--tr), color var(--tr);\n  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;\n}\n.rail-item:hover:not(.locked):not(.active) .rail-icon{\n  transform:scale(1.18);\n  color:#3a5cbb;\n}\n.rail-item.active:hover .rail-icon{color:#f8fafc;transform:scale(1.1)}\n.rail-item.active .rail-icon{\n  transform:scale(1.1);\n  color:#f8fafc;\n}\n/* Labels hidden \u2014 icons-only rail with tooltip on hover */\n.rail-label{display:none}\n\n/* Active dot indicator */\n.rail-dot{\n  position:absolute;right:5px;top:5px;\n  width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;\n  background:var(--b400);opacity:0;transition:opacity var(--tr);\n}\n.rail-item.active .rail-dot{opacity:1}\n\n/* Tooltip on hover */\n.rail-tooltip{\n  position:absolute;left:calc(100% + 14px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(-6px);\n  background:rgba(15,23,42,.92);\n  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(140%);\n  backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(140%);\n  color:#f8fafc;\n  box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.25), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08);\n  padding:7px 12px;border-radius:8px;\n  font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.01em;\n  white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;\n  opacity:0;transition:opacity .18s ease, transform .18s ease;\n  z-index:999;\n}\n.rail-tooltip::before{\n  content:'';position:absolute;right:100%;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);\n  border:6px solid transparent;border-right-color:rgba(15,23,42,.92);\n}\n.rail-item:hover .rail-tooltip{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(0)}\n\n/* \u2500\u2500 SLIDE-OUT PANEL \u2500\u2500 */\n.sb-panel-shell{\n  width:0;overflow:hidden;\n  background:var(--sb-bg);\n  border-right:1px solid var(--sb-border);\n  transition:width .25s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);\n  display:flex;flex-direction:column;\n  height:100%;\n}\n.sb-panel-shell.open{width:var(--panel-w)}\n\n.sb-panel{\n  display:none;\n  flex-direction:column;\n  width:var(--panel-w);\n  height:100%;\n  overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;\n  padding-bottom:16px;\n  scrollbar-width:thin;\n  scrollbar-color:#cbd5e1 transparent;\n}\n.sb-panel::-webkit-scrollbar{width:3px}\n.sb-panel::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#cbd5e1;border-radius:2px}\n.sb-panel.active{display:flex}\n\n/* Panel header */\n.sb-panel-hdr{\n  padding:18px 16px 12px;\n  border-bottom:1px solid var(--sb-border);\n  flex-shrink:0;\n}\n.sb-panel-hdr-title{display:none}\n.sb-panel-hdr-name{\n  font-size:15px;font-weight:800;\n  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;\n  color:#4b73e1;\n  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;\n}\n.sb-panel-hdr-name i.lni{font-size:21px;color:#4b73e1}\n\n/* Section labels */\n.sb-section{\n  font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;\n  letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--sb-section-clr);\n  padding:16px 14px 5px;\n}\n\n/* Collapsible group */\n.sb-group-hdr{\n  display:flex;align-items:center;\n  padding:9px 14px 7px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;\n  font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;\n  letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--sb-section-clr);\n  transition:color var(--tr);\n  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;\n}\n.sb-group-hdr > span:first-child{\n  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;\n  flex:1;min-width:0;\n}\n.sb-group-hdr:hover{color:#334155}\n.sb-chevron{\n  margin-left:auto;font-size:9px;opacity:.6;\n  transition:transform .2s ease;display:inline-block;\n}\n.sb-collapse.closed .sb-chevron{transform:rotate(-90deg)}\n.sb-collapse-body{\n  overflow:hidden;\n  max-height:600px;opacity:1;\n  transition:max-height .28s ease, opacity .2s ease;\n}\n.sb-collapse.closed .sb-collapse-body{max-height:0;opacity:0}\n\n/* Nav items */\n.sb-item{\n  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;\n  padding:8px 14px;margin:1px 8px;\n  cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;\n  color:var(--sb-text);\n  border-radius:8px;\n  border-left:2px solid transparent;\n  transition:background var(--tr), color var(--tr), border-color var(--tr);\n  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;\n}\n.sb-item:hover{\n  background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);\n  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(140%);\n  backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(140%);\n  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.65), 0 3px 10px rgba(15,23,42,.06);\n  color:var(--sb-text-hover);\n}\n.sb-item.active{\n  background:var(--sb-item-active-bg);\n  border-color:var(--sb-item-active-border);\n  color:var(--sb-item-active-text);\n  font-weight:600;\n}\n.sb-icon{\n  font-size:14px;\n  width:22px;height:22px;\n  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;\n  flex-shrink:0;opacity:.75;\n}\n.sb-icon i.lni{font-size:15px;line-height:1;display:block}\n.sb-item.active .sb-icon{opacity:1}\n.sb-badge{\n  margin-left:auto;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;\n  padding:2px 7px;border-radius:10px;flex-shrink:0;\n  background:rgba(59,130,246,.22);color:#93c5fd;\n}\n.sb-badge.warn{background:rgba(245,158,11,.2);color:#fbbf24}\n.sb-badge.green{background:rgba(16,185,129,.2);color:#34d399}\n.sb-badge.purple{background:rgba(124,58,237,.2);color:#a78bfa}\n\n/* Panel footer */\n.sb-panel-footer{\n  margin-top:auto;padding:10px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--sb-border);\n  font-size:10px;color:#94a3b8;flex-shrink:0;\n}\n\n/* \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n   MAIN CONTENT\n\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550 */\n.main{\n  flex:1;\n  margin-left:var(--rail-w);\n  padding:24px 28px;\n  min-width:0;\n  transition:margin-left .25s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);\n}\n.main.panel-open{margin-left:calc(var(--rail-w) + var(--panel-w))}\n\n.page{display:none}\n.page.active{display:block}\n.pg-hdr{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}\n.pg-title{font-family:'Inter',-apple-system,sans-serif;font-size:21px;font-weight:800;color:var(--g900);letter-spacing:-0.02em}\n.pg-sub{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--g400);margin-top:3px}\n\n/* \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n   CARDS\n\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550 */\n.card{background:var(--white);border:1.5px solid var(--g200);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:20px;box-shadow:var(--neu-out);margin-bottom:18px}\n.card-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}\n.card-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--g900);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}\n.card-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--g500);margin-top:2px}\n\n/* \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n   GRIDS\n\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550 */\n.g2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}\n.g3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:16px}\n.g4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px}\n.fg.span2{grid-column:span 2}\n.fg.span3{grid-column:span 3}\n.fg.span4{grid-column:span 4}\n\n/* \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n   STATS ROW\n\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550 */\n.stats-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;margin-bottom:24px}\n.stat-card{\n  background:var(--white);border:1.5px solid var(--g200);border-radius:var(--radius);\n  padding:18px 20px;box-shadow:var(--neu-out);position:relative;overflow:hidden;\n}\n.stat-card::before{\n  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;\n  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--b700),var(--b400));\n  border-radius:var(--radius) var(--radius) 0 0;\n}\n.stat-num{font-size:26px;font-weight:800;font-family:'Inter',-apple-system,sans-serif;color:var(--g900);margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:-0.025em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}\n.stat-lbl{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--g500);font-weight:500;margin-top:3px}\n.stat-sub{font-size:11px;margin-top:7px;font-weight:600}\n.stat-sub.up{color:var(--green)}.stat-sub.warn{color:var(--amber)}.stat-sub.dn{color:var(--red)}\n\n/* \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n   PIPELINE\n\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550 */\n.pipeline{display:flex;align-items:center;margin-bottom:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}\n.pip-step{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 18px;background:var(--white);border:1.5px solid var(--g200);border-radius:var(--rsm);box-shadow:var(--neu-sm);flex:1;min-width:140px}\n.pip-step.done{border-color:var(--green-bd);background:var(--green-bg)}\n.pip-step.active{border-color:var(--b300);background:var(--b50)}\n.pip-step.warn{border-color:var(--amber-bd);background:var(--amber-bg)}\n.pip-circle{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--g300);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;flex-shrink:0}\n.pip-step.done .pip-circle{background:var(--green)}\n.pip-step.active .pip-circle{background:var(--b600)}\n.pip-step.warn .pip-circle{background:var(--amber)}\n\n/* Admission Dashboard \u2014 uniform white tile background; status comes via the circle */\n#page-dashboard .pipeline .pip-step,\n#page-dashboard .pipeline .pip-step.done,\n#page-dashboard .pipeline .pip-step.active,\n#page-dashboard .pipeline .pip-step.warn{\n  background:var(--white);\n  border-color:var(--g200);\n}\n#page-dashboard .pipeline .pip-circle{\n  background:var(--b600);\n  color:#fff;\n}\n\n/* Admission Progress Charts (Dashboard) */\n.adm-chart-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.35fr 1fr;gap:24px}\n@media(max-width:900px){.adm-chart-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px}}\n.adm-chart-col{min-width:0}\n.adm-chart-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--g900);letter-spacing:-0.01em}\n.adm-chart-sub{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--g500);margin-top:2px;margin-bottom:14px}\n\n/* Donut chart \u2014 Application Source Mix */\n.donut-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:6px 0}\n.donut-svg-wrap{\n  width:180px;height:180px;flex-shrink:0;\n  filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(15,30,61,.08));\n}\n.donut{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}\n.donut-seg{transition:stroke-width .2s ease}\n.donut-seg:hover{stroke-width:16}\n.donut-center-num{font-family:'Inter',-apple-system,sans-serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:800;fill:var(--g900);letter-spacing:-0.025em}\n.donut-center-lbl{font-family:'Inter',-apple-system,sans-serif;font-size:5.5px;font-weight:700;fill:var(--g400);letter-spacing:.18em}\n.donut-legend{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px 14px;min-width:0}\n.donut-legend-item{\n  display:grid;\n  grid-template-columns:10px minmax(0,1fr) auto auto;\n  align-items:center;gap:8px;\n  padding:6px 8px;\n  background:var(--surface);\n  border:1px solid var(--g200);\n  border-radius:var(--rxs);\n}\n.donut-swatch{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;display:inline-block;flex-shrink:0}\n.donut-legend-lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--g700);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;min-width:0}\n.donut-legend-val{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:var(--g900);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;min-width:18px;text-align:right;letter-spacing:-0.01em}\n.donut-legend-pct{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--g500);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;min-width:30px;text-align:right;letter-spacing:.01em}\n@media(max-width:560px){.donut-legend{grid-template-columns:1fr}}\n\n/* Metrics strip below donut */\n.donut-metrics{\n  margin-top:18px;\n  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;\n  background:var(--surface);\n  border:1.5px solid var(--g200);\n  border-radius:var(--rsm);\n  overflow:hidden;\n}\n.donut-metric{\n  padding:11px 14px;\n  border-right:1px solid var(--g200);\n}\n.donut-metric:last-child{border-right:none}\n.donut-metric-lbl{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--g500)}\n.donut-metric-val{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:var(--g900);margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:-0.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.1}\n.donut-metric-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--g500);margin-top:2px;font-weight:500}\n\n/* Profile photo uploader (used on Application Payment + ODel Student Preview) */\n.prof-photo-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:14px 0 18px;margin-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--g100)}\n.prof-photo-zone{\n  position:relative;\n  width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:50%;\n  flex-shrink:0;\n  background:var(--surface);\n  border:2px dashed var(--g300);\n  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;\n  cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;\n  transition:border-color var(--tr), background var(--tr);\n}\n.prof-photo-zone:hover{border-color:var(--b500);background:var(--b50)}\n.prof-photo-zone.has-photo{border-style:solid;border-color:var(--b500)}\n.prof-photo-zone input[type=file]{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;width:100%;height:100%}\n.prof-photo-icon{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;color:var(--g400);font-size:22px;font-weight:600;pointer-events:none}\n.prof-photo-icon small{font-size:10px;color:var(--g400);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase}\n.prof-photo-preview{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:none}\n.prof-photo-zone.has-photo .prof-photo-preview{display:block}\n.prof-photo-zone.has-photo .prof-photo-icon{display:none}\n.prof-photo-info{min-width:0}\n.prof-photo-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--g900);letter-spacing:-0.01em}\n.prof-photo-hint{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--g500);margin-top:3px}\n\n/* Funnel \u2014 left label + centered horizontal bar that narrows each row */\n.funnel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}\n.funnel-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr;align-items:center;gap:10px}\n.funnel-row-label{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--g700);letter-spacing:-0.01em;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}\n.funnel-bar-track{display:flex;justify-content:center;min-width:0}\n.funnel-bar{\n  width:var(--w,100%);\n  min-width:46px;\n  height:32px;\n  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;\n  padding:0 12px;\n  border-radius:6px;\n  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--b700),var(--b500));\n  color:#fff;\n  box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(45,68,143,.18);\n  transition:width .35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);\n}\n.funnel-bar-final{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#059669,#10b981);box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(5,150,105,.22)}\n.funnel-count{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-0.01em}\n.funnel-arrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px :first-child{visibility:hidden}\n.funnel-arrow-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;color:var(--g500);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em}\n.funnel-arrow-inner span{color:var(--g300);font-size:13px}\n\n/* Stage-to-Stage Conversion */\n.conv-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:13px}\n.conv-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}\n.conv-hdr{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:8px}\n.conv-from{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--g700);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;min-width:0}\n.conv-pct{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-0.01em;flex-shrink:0}\n.conv-pct-high{color:var(--green)}\n.conv-pct-low{color:#dc2626}\n.conv-track{height:10px;background:var(--g100);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--g200)}\n.conv-fill{height:100%;border-radius:6px;transition:width .35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}\n.conv-fill-high{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#10b981,#059669)}\n.conv-fill-low{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f87171,#dc2626)}\n.conv-meta{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--g500);font-weight:500}\n.conv-summary{\n  margin-top:16px;padding:14px 16px;\n  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--b50),#fff);\n  border:1.5px solid var(--b200);border-radius:var(--rsm);\n  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;\n}\n.conv-summary-lbl{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--b700)}\n.conv-summary-meta{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--g500);margin-top:3px}\n.conv-summary-val{font-size:26px;font-weight:800;color:var(--b800);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-0.025em}\n.pip-label{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--g900)}\n.pip-desc{font-size:11px;color:var(--g500)}\n.pip-line{height:2px;width:20px;background:var(--g300);flex-shrink:0}\n.pip-line.done{background:var(--green)}\n\n/*   MODALS\n\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550 */\n.modal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,30,61,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);z-index:500;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px}\n.modal-overlay.open{display:flex}\n.modal{background:var(--white);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:0   TOAST\n\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550 */\n.toast{position:fixed;bottom:24px;right:24px;background:var(--g900);color:#fff;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:var(--rsm);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;box-shadow:0 6px 24px \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n   TIMETABLE\n\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550 */\n.tt-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:80px repeat(6,1fr);gap:2px;font-size:11.5px}\n.tt-hdr{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--b800),var(--b600));color:#fff;padding:8px return; }\n  var tr = document.createElement('tr');\n  tr.innerHTML =\n    '<td style=\"font-family:monospace\">'+code+'<\u002Ftd>'+\n    '<td><strong>'+name+'<\u002Fstrong> <span class=\"badge badge-green\" style=\"font-size:10px;margin-left:4px\">New<\u002Fspan><\u002Ftd>'+\n    '<td>'+dean+'<\u002Ftd>'+\n    '<td>'+progs+'<\u002Ftd>'+\n    '<td>'+units+'<\u002Ftd>'+\n    '<td><button class=\"btn btn-neu btn-sm\"><i class=\"lni lni-pencil\"><\u002Fi> Edit<\u002Fbutton><\u002Ftd>';\n  tbody.appendChild(tr);\n  closeModal('new-faculty-modal');\n  toast('<i class=\"lni lni-checkmark\"><\u002Fi> Faculty '+code+' \u2014 '+name+' added.','success');\n  // clear form\n  ['nf-code','nf-name','nf-dean'].forEach(function(id){ document.getElementById(id).value=''; });\n  document.getElementById('nf-progs').value=0;\n  document.getElementById('nf-units').value=0;\n  // briefly highlight new row\n  tr.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});\n  tr.style.background='var(--green-bg)';\n  setTimeout(function(){ tr.style.background=''; },2400);\n}\n\nfunction saveNewLecturer(){\n  var title = document.getElementById('nl-title').value;\n  var fn = (document.getElementById('nl-fname').value||'').trim();\n  var ln = (document.getElementById('nl-lname').value||'').trim();\n  var qual = document.getElementById('nl-qual').value;\n  var field = (document.getElementById('nl-field').value||'').trim();\n  var inst = (document.getElementById('nl-inst').value||'').trim();\n  var yr   = (document.getElementById('nl-year').value||'').trim();\n  var spec = (document.getElementById('nl-spec').value||'').trim();\n  var fac  = document.getElementById('nl-faculty').value;\n  var desig= document.getElementById('nl-desig').value;\n  var statusV = document.getElementById('nl-status').value;\n  var phone = (document.getElementById('nl-phone').value||'').trim();\n  var emailIn = (document.getElementById('nl-email').value||'').trim();\n\n  if(!fn){ toast('First name is required.','warn'); return; }\n  if(!ln){ toast('Last name is required.','warn'); return; }\n  if(!field){ toast('Field of study is required.','warn'); return; }\n  if(!inst){ toast('Institution is required.','warn'); return; }\n\n  var tbody = document.getElementById('lecturer-master-tbody');\n  if(!tbody){ toast('Lecturer table not found.','warn'); return; }\n  // auto-generate ID\n  var n = tbody.children.length + 1;\n  var lid = 'LEC-' + String(n).padStart(4,'0');\n  var email = emailIn || (fn[0].toLowerCase() + ln.split(' ').pop().toLowerCase() + '@isbatuniversity.ac.ug');\n  var statusBadgeClass = statusV==='Active'?'badge-green':statusV==='On Leave'?'badge-amber':statusV==='Visiting'?'badge-cyan':'badge-red';\n  var desigBadgeClass  = desig==='Professor'?'badge-purple':desig==='Associate Professor'?'badge-purple':'badge-blue';\n  var qualLine = qual + (field?' '+field:'') ;\n  var instLine = inst + (yr?' \u00b7 '+yr:'');\n\n  var tr = document.createElement('tr');\n  tr.innerHTML =\n    '<td style=\"font-family:monospace;color:var(--b700)\">'+lid+'<\u002Ftd>'+\n    '<td><strong>'+title+' '+fn+' '+ln+'<\u002Fstrong><div style=\"font-size:11px;color:var(--g500)\">'+email+'<\u002Fdiv><\u002Ftd>'+\n    '<td>'+qualLine+'<div style=\"font-size:11px;color:var(--g500)\">'+instLine+'<\u002Fdiv><\u002Ftd>'+\n    '<td>'+(spec||'\u2014')+'<\u002Ftd>'+\n    '<td>'+fac+'<\u002Ftd>'+\n    '<td><span class=\"badge '+desigBadgeClass+'\">'+desig+'<\u002Fspan><\u002Ftd>'+\n    '<td><span class=\"badge '+statusBadgeClass+'\"><span class=\"bdot\"><\u002Fspan>'+statusV+'<\u002Fspan><\u002Ftd>'+\n    '<td><button class=\"btn btn-neu btn-sm\"><i class=\"lni lni-pencil\"><\u002Fi> Edit<\u002Fbutton><\u002Ftd>';\n  tbody.appendChild(tr);\n\n  var cnt = document.getElementById('lecturer-count'); if(cnt) cnt.textContent = tbody.children.length;\n  closeModal('new-lecturer-modal');\n  toast('<i class=\"lni lni-checkmark\"><\u002Fi> Lecturer '+lid+' \u2014 '+title+' '+fn+' '+ln+' added.','success');\n  ['nl-fname','nl-lname','nl-email','nl-phone','nl-field','nl-inst','nl-year','nl-spec'].forEach(function(id){\n    var el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.value='';\n  });\n  document.getElementById('nl-exp').value=0;\n  tr.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});\n  tr.style.background='var(--green-bg)';\n  setTimeout(function(){ tr.style.background=''; },2400);\n}\n\n/* \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n   STUDENT LOOKUP\n\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550 */\nfunction searchStudent(){\n  const q = document.getElementById('student-search-input')?.value.trim();\n  if(q && q.length>2) toast('Searching students... (cross-module lookup via Service 10)','');\n}\n\n/* \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n   INIT\n\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550 */\n\n/* \u2500\u2500\u2500 DYNAMIC STUB MODALS \u2500\u2500\u2500 */\n(function() {\n  var stubs = {\n    'manual-alloc-modal': '<i class=\"lni lni-graduation\"><\u002Fi> Manual Allocation',\n    'new-cw-modal':        '<i class=\"lni lni-pencil-alt\"><\u002Fi> Schedule Coursework',\n    'new-cbt-modal':       '<i class=\"lni lni-display\"><\u002Fi> Schedule Class Test (CBT)',\n    'new-qp-modal':        '<i class=\"lni lni-files\"><\u002Fi> Upload Question Paper',\n    'new-equating-modal':  '<i class=\"lni lni-world\"><\u002Fi> New Qualification Equating'\n  };\n  Object.keys(stubs).forEach(function(id) {\n    if (document.getElementById(id)) return;\n    var d = document.createElement('div');\n    d.className = 'modal-overlay'; d.id = id;\n    d.innerHTML =\n      '<div class=\"modal modal-md\">' +\n        '<div class=\"modal-hdr\">' +\n          '<div class=\"modal-title\">' + stubs[id] + '<\u002Fdiv>' +\n          '<button class=\"modal-close\" onclick=\"closeModal(\\'' + id + '\\')\"><i class=\"lni lni-close\"><\u002Fi><\u002Fbutton>' +\n        '<\u002Fdiv>' +\n        '<div style=\"padding:18px 22px\">' +\n          '<div class=\"undefined-box\">' +\n            '<div style=\"font-size:26px;margin-bottom:8px\"><i class=\"lni lni-construction\"><\u002Fi><\u002Fdiv>' +\n            '<div style=\"font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--b700)\">' + stubs[id] + '<\u002Fdiv>' +\n            '<div style=\"font-size:13px;color:var(--g500);margin-top:6px\">Full implementation coming in the next sprint.<\u002Fdiv>' +\n          '<\u002Fdiv>' +\n        '<\u002Fdiv>' +\n        '<div class=\"modal-footer\">' +\n          '<button class=\"btn btn-neu\" onclick=\"closeModal(\\'' + id + '\\')\">Close<\u002Fbutton>' +\n        '<\u002Fdiv>' +\n      '<\u002Fdiv>';\n    d.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === d) d.classList.remove('open'); });\n    document.body.appendChild(d);\n  });\n})();\n\n/* \u2500\u2500\u2500 INIT \u2500\u2500\u2500 */\ndocument.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {\n  /* modal overlay click-outside-to-close */\n  document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay').forEach(function(o) {\n    o.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === o) o.classList.remove('open'); });\n  });\n\n  /* init timetable */\n  if (typeof renderTimetable === 'function') renderTimetable();\n\n  /* open Admission module by default */\n  switchModule('academic');\n});\n<\u002Fscript>\n\n<\u002Fbody><\u002Fhtml>"</script>
